content:
Last week, Apple filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, accusing its former employees of stealing trade secrets "for the benefit of OpenAI."

It is reported that during the litigation process, Apple has directly contacted several former employees who currently work at OpenAI.

According to the Financial Times, Apple has issued evidence preservation notices to approximately 40 former employees.

An evidence preservation notice is a formal written notification sent to an individual or organisation, requiring them to preserve documents, records, and other evidence that may be involved in a legal dispute. Such notices typically specify the exact materials that must be preserved.

This move suggests Apple's suspicion that the theft of trade secrets may extend beyond the scope of individuals named in last week's complaint.

A refresher: Apple's lawsuit names OpenAI and io Products as defendants, and also names former Apple employees Chang Liu and Tang Tan.
